author: Forbes
description:
Mercor’s three 23-year-old cofounders just doubled their fortunes after their company announced Tuesday it raised $750 million from investors including Benchmark, General Catalyst, Nvidia and Salesforce. At Mercor’s new $20 billion valuation, Forbes estimates that CEO Brendan Foody, CTO Adarsh Hiremath and board chairman Surya Midha are worth $4.2 billion each from their 21% stakes in the company.

That’s up from $2.2 billion in October 2025, when Mercor raised $350 million at a $10 billion valuation and made its three cofounders the world’s youngest self-made billionaires at the age of 22. They supplanted Polymarket CEO Shayne Coplan, who was 27 at the time, and beat out Mark Zuckerberg, who first became a billionaire at age 23, for the title of youngest self-made billionaire ever. They still hold both titles today. (Midha is the youngest cofounder by roughly two months). Mercor declined to comment on Forbes’ net worth estimates.

Read the full story on Forbes: https://www.forbes.com
title: The World’s Youngest Self-Made Billionaires Just Doubled Their Fortunes
